attributes.title: Hide header

lesson.concept: Direction needs hysteresis and boundary handling
lesson.why: The header responds to sustained travel in a direction rather than every tiny delta. The scroll position is clamped and edge zones prevent rubber-band recoil from looking like deliberate reverse scrolling.
lesson.experiment: Scroll down, reverse slightly, then reverse decisively. Repeat near the top and bottom and compare Floating header with Instant response.
lesson.pitfall: Using the raw sign of every scroll delta makes the bar flicker under trackpad noise and iOS overscroll.
lesson.combine: Combine with reveal while keeping the primary navigation reachable and the page's content position stable.
